title: ExtendedChat
description: A modular and modern chat for Folia/Paper.
body:
![asd](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/4cf7dbd570b076ccc80108d1ab30c657a504e7af/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f4c4c766b6131302e706e67)
![asdd](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/c2daff2c61826d5b78b1732b2f05723f31ef15e4/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f554b44387930762e6a706567)

## Dependencies
[MapacheeeLib](https://github.com/Mapacheee/MapacheeeLib/releases/tag/v1.0.0), 
[PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi)

## Commands
- /extendedchat reload | reload plugins
- /sc <message> | send message to staff chat
- /sc | switch staff chat
- /color | open color GUI
- /msg, /tell, /w | send a private message
- /r, /reply | reply a private message

## Permissions​
- extendedchat.color | open GUI with basic colors
- extendedchat.color.hex | Access to HEXs colors
- extendedchat.color.gradients | Access to gradients colors
- extendedchat.color.ingame | use tags color in game
- extendedchat.staff | Access to chat staff
- extendedchat.antispam.bypass | Bypass anti spam filter
- extendedchat.antilink.bypass | Bypass anti link filter

## Placeholders
- %extendedchat_message_color% (Minimessage format)
- %extendedchat_message_color_legacy% (&#RRGGBB format)
- %extendedchat_name_color% (Minimessage format)
- %extendedchat_name_color_legacy% (&#RRGGBB format)
